content.title: Performance-to-Environment Pullback | Face Close-Up to Full World
content.summary: Start on an identity-clear facial performance and keep it uninterrupted. One continuous pullback gradually transfers visual dominance from face to body to the responding environment; the performer remains identifiable while the world becomes the final subject.

quick_start.input_format: Close-face performance benchmark + continuous retreat lens + layer-by-layer environment reference + uninterrupted character movements + panoramic final state of the relationship between people and scenes
quick_start.recommended_input: The original wind dancer continues to perform from a close-up view of the face, and the camera continuously recedes to reveal the costumes, walking trails, sea cliffs and sky light strips, and finally the human scene is in the same frame.
required_anchors: Open close enough to establish one stable performer identity.
Keep one continuous performance thread through the camera retreat.
Transfer visual dominance through camera distance rather than a subject transformation.
End wide with both performer and responsive environment readable.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Start on an identity-clear facial performance and keep it uninterrupted. One continuous pullback gradually transfers visual dominance from face to body to the responding environment; the performer remains identifiable while the world becomes the final subject.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin in an identity-close performance frame, keep the performance continuous while one unbroken pullback gradually transfers visual dominance from face to body and then to a responsive environment, and end with the performer still readable inside the now-dominant wide setting.

invariants.rule: Open close enough to establish one stable performer identity.
invariants.purpose: Gives the later scale transfer a human anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening wide makes the performer secondary too early.

invariants.rule: Keep one continuous performance thread through the camera retreat.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the pullback from becoming scenery montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping performance breaks the causal link.

invariants.rule: Reveal the first environmental response before the frame becomes wide.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden final background replacement feels unrelated.

invariants.rule: Transfer visual dominance through camera distance rather than a subject transformation.
invariants.purpose: Makes the scale shift legible and reusable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing the performer instead of the frame changes the mechanism.

invariants.rule: End wide with both performer and responsive environment readable.
invariants.purpose: Completes the relationship without losing identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: A landscape-only ending discards the opening anchor.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source translucent dress and face lighting

instantiations.concept: A glass-bowl artisan begins in a close face-and-hands frame; one continuous retreat reveals resonating bowls, then a bioluminescent greenhouse canopy responding in expanding rings while the artisan keeps circling one mallet.
